_comment: Regression gate for the deterministic CI tier. Update deliberately, in its own commit, with the evaluation report that justifies the new numbers. Raising a threshold to make a red build green is the exact failure mode this project exists to prevent.
_semantics: Every number in this file is a TARGET THRESHOLD chosen by a human, not a measurement. Measured values are never written here automatically.
_measured_values: reports/retrieval_baseline.json holds the measured Phase B retrieval baseline. Compare against it before changing any threshold below.
_unvalidated_note: The end_to_end and ragas thresholds have never been measured; no LLM tier has run. Treat them as placeholders until a measured report exists.
